hazards.title: Clinician Automation Bias Leading to Unreviewed Target Approval

mitigations.description: User interface prohibits preselecting default target candidate.
System enforces human clinician as sole prescriptive authority.
Specialist shall be able to reject all candidates and record no selected target.
Software shall not autonomously prescribe frequency, intensity, pulse count, or session schedule.

hazards.title: Coordinate Space Mismatch and Spatial Transformation Inversion in Target Export

mitigations.description: Canonical coordinate object explicitly includes coordinate space metadata and validation checksums.
Deterministic spatial bounds checking and offline coordinate validation in Target Engine.
Structural and functional registration preserves anatomical coordinate space integrity.
Laterality flip prevention enforced across all coordinate transformation pipelines.

hazards.title: Corrupted Connectome Guidance Due to Excessive Motion or Low SNR

mitigations.description: Automated motion QC filtering (mean FD < 0.25 mm) and fallback to evidence priors.
Motion QC filtering gates functional connectivity personalisation.
Strict evidence ceiling bounds on target candidates.
Reliability thresholds enforced as hard gates prior to compensable score calculation.

hazards.title: Target Generation Based on Stale or Inappropriate Clinical Phenotype

mitigations.description: Immutable phenotype snapshot required prior to targeting.
Formal phenotype ontology and DSM-5 symptom dimension validation.
Strict state transitions on clinical cases and snapshot validity expiration.
Material change in clinician-approved indication context requires new analysis rather than slate mutation.

hazards.title: Cross-Tenant Medical Data Breach via Broken Authorization

mitigations.description: Mandatory clinical user authentication and gateway access validation.
Database-level Row Level Security (RLS) isolation across organizations.
Immutable audit logging of all clinical record access with cryptographic chaining.

hazards.title: Incorrect Indication Module Activation in Multi-Indication Environment

mitigations.description: Target Slate references exactly one immutable IndicationModuleRelease.
Clinical authority resolved per CaseIndication and IndicationModuleRelease, not global flag.
Fail closed if active module cannot positively resolve to approved compatibility configuration.
Scientific policy binds exact IndicationModuleRelease to permitted generator and measurement manifests.

hazards.title: Cross-Module Evidence or Scientific Parameter Leakage

mitigations.description: EvidencePaths prohibited from automatically transferring between indication modules.
Multi-indication evidence graphs strictly isolated by indication scope.
Evidence Governance Classification strictly distinguishes Research vs Clinical evidence tiers.
Target candidate without valid EvidencePath prohibited from entering Target Slate.

hazards.title: Research Science or Unvalidated Generator Leaking into Clinical Operation

mitigations.description: Module with research_only status structurally prohibited from Clinical slates.
Clinician override cannot convert Research-only scientific object into Clinical candidate.
Same deployment supports modules at different maturity states without authority leakage.
Clinical shell warns that executable scientific capability shall not be represented as validated solely by existence.

hazards.title: Lesion Laterality, Anatomical Distortion, or Necrotic Core Targeting

mitigations.description: Lesion laterality explicitly represented as left hemisphere, right hemisphere, bilateral, or non-lesional.
Stroke motor targeting preserves affected limb laterality without hemisphere crossover.
Structural lesion distortion invalidating standard stereotaxy causes module abstention.
Preservation of lesion context and cranioplasty structural distortion boundaries.

hazards.title: Motor Mapping Somatotopy Misinterpretation or Body-Region Mismatch

mitigations.description: Motor-map candidates require explicit SomatotopicTargetGeometry matching clinical territory.
Muscle recording, affected body region, and target geometry must match without somatotopic mismatch.
Somatotopic M1 candidates require validated SomatotopicTargetGeometry.
Somatotopic pain target preserves affected body region without generic M1 point substitution.
Generic universal M1 point prohibited from replacing required somatotopic search region.
Bilateral or ambiguous pain shall not result in arbitrary hemisphere selection.

hazards.title: Audiological / Tinnitus Overinterpretation Generating Invalid Cortical Target

mitigations.description: Tinnitus pitch/loudness matching prohibited from autonomously generating targets.
Hearing-loss pattern shall not autonomously generate an auditory-cortex target coordinate.
Initial Tinnitus targeting module remains Research-only until prospective qualification.
Clinical target generation for tinnitus fails closed without approved Clinical release.

hazards.title: Target Geometry Corruption or Lossy Downcasting (e.g. Deep-TMS Field to Point)

mitigations.description: mPFC/ACC deep-TMS targets preserve coil_field geometry without lossy downcasting.
Target Engine prohibited from downcasting coil_field target to single point coordinate.
Incompatible device / coil class fails target-geometry / candidate validation.

hazards.title: Treatment Context Omission for Evidence-Dependent Protocol Requirements

mitigations.description: Symptom provocation requirement explicitly verified before targeting analysis.
Absence or uncertainty of required treatment context produces explicit slate warning or abstention.
Treatment-context restrictions enforceable where declared evidence-relevant.
Where evidence depends on concurrent speech therapy, treatment context requirement is enforceable.

hazards.title: Wrong Indication or Clinical Objective Mismatch in Multi-Indication Cases

mitigations.description: Every targeting analysis shall identify the principal CaseIndication being addressed.
Specialist shall explicitly approve clinical objective(s) prior to target generation.
Software shall not infer treatment objective solely from diagnosis.
Persistent Case Header exposes active principal CaseIndication and prevents cross-indication slate reuse.

hazards.title: Unreliable TMS-MEP Motor Mapping Influencing Cortical Target Refinement

mitigations.description: Each measurement modality carries independent QC status and reliability metric.
Non-MRI modalities (MEP, motor mapping, audiology) conform to canonical schema with provenance.
Unreliable motor mapping falls back to evidence baseline rather than distorted coordinates.
Motor-map refinement requires qualified motor-hotspot / motor-map confidence metrics.

hazards.title: Misleading Task-fMRI Interpretation and Task Failure Conflation

mitigations.description: Failed mandatory modality causes target engine abstention rather than silent omission.
Patient-specific sophistication shall not automatically outrank evidence-supported non-personalised baseline.
Failure of a task-fMRI language paradigm shall not be represented as absence of language cortex.
Failure of mandatory lesion/stage requirement causes module abstention.

hazards.title: Invalid Tractography Interpretation as Biological Ground Truth

mitigations.description: Patient measurements encapsulated inside versioned MeasurementBundle objects with tractography method provenance.
Patient-specific tractography maximum prohibited from autonomously outranking evidence baseline.
Structural connectivity reliability thresholds enforced as hard gates prior to candidate scoring.

hazards.title: Hidden or Heuristic Multimodal Fusion Collapsing Discordant Modalities

mitigations.description: Multimodal fusion prohibited without explicit indication-module scientific policy permission.
Scientific policy defaults to multimodal_fusion_policy = prohibited or descriptive_only.
Separate patient measurement, scientific evidence, algorithmic inference, and clinician decision.

hazards.title: Incompatible Coil or Delivery Device Applied to Field-Defined Evidence

mitigations.description: Incompatible device / coil class fails target-geometry / candidate validation.
Hard safety gates strictly precede compensable ranking weight calculations.
Software shall not autonomously prescribe frequency, intensity, or device setup.

hazards.title: Silent Target Drift or Provenance Invalidation Across Module Upgrades

mitigations.description: Historical v1 and v2 Target Slates reconstructable from original scientific release configuration.
Modifying scientific policy parameters creates a new immutable release version without mutating existing slates.
Clinical scientific versions frozen for formal verification.
Bit-for-bit Target Engine determinism across runs.
